answer_1.quote: Our experiments use three question-answering datasets assessing factual knowledge.

answer_2.quote: We measure calibration with multiple metrics. To measure ECE (expected calibration error; ), we bin model predictions by their confidence and measure the average accuracy of predictions in each confidence bin.

answer_3.quote: To avoid excessive false negatives in our correctness computation as a result of exact-match evaluation, we use either GPT-4 or GPT-3.5 to evaluate whether a response is essentially equivalent to the ground truth answer; see Appendix C for the complete equivalence-checking procedure.
